name: Yukimura Touko
source: A transfer student just like [url=/c21481]Ryousuke[/url]. Because she likes her old school's uniform, she keeps on wearing it, which makes her stand out. Despite being popular, she isn't very outgoing and doesn't like to do stuff she finds troublesome. She likes taking naps everyday after school in the old school building, because it's quiet there. Despite it being closed down, she somehow has a key to the building.
